articles.image_title: Asylreform in der EU: Human rights activists from Italy, Albania and other European countries carry a placard depicting images of (From L) European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, US President Donald Trump, Albania's Prime Minister Edi Rama and Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni during a protest against the migrant camps built under a deal between Rome and Tirana, outside the Albanian Government headquarters in Tirana on November 1, 2025. A little over a year after Italy opened migrant camps in Albania intended to hold people intercepted at sea, the legally contested centres such as the controversial facilities in Gjader and Shengjin, lie almost empty. Numerous NGOs have criticised living conditions inside the camps, and Italian courts have struck down several attempted deportations to Albania.
